info.name: KSI Collision Fatality API
info.description:
Deliverable 5 — client tests for the Flask analytics API serving the Neural Network (calibrated) model at threshold 0.0197.

Start the API with `python app.py`, then run this collection.

The /predict bodies are real held-out test records that were never used to train the model; each request's description gives the recorded outcome so the prediction can be checked against it.

request.description: Confirms the API is up and reports which model and threshold are loaded.
Lists all 30 features the model accepts, with valid categorical options and numeric ranges.
Returns test-split records the model never trained on, with their true outcomes.
